facts.fact_en: EVMs in India are standalone devices with no Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, or internet connectivity. They cannot be remotely hacked.
facts.fact_hi: भारत की EVM मशीनें standalone होती हैं - कोई Wi-Fi, Bluetooth या internet नहीं होता। इन्हें remotely hack नहीं किया जा सकता।

sources.title: Election Commission of India - EVM FAQ

facts.fact_en: Each voter can vote only once. The indelible ink mark and EPIC card verification prevent duplicate voting.
facts.fact_hi: हर voter सिर्फ एक बार vote कर सकता है। indelible ink और EPIC card verification से duplicate voting नहीं हो सकती।

facts.fact_en: NOTA (None Of The Above) is a valid voting option introduced by the Supreme Court in 2013.
facts.fact_hi: NOTA (None Of The Above) एक valid voting option है, जिसे Supreme Court ने 2013 में introduce किया था।

facts.fact_en: Candidates must declare criminal cases in their affidavit filed with the Election Commission. This is public information.
facts.fact_hi: Candidates को Election Commission में file किए गए affidavit में criminal cases declare करने होते हैं। यह public information है।

facts.fact_en: VVPAT machines print a paper slip showing your vote after you press the EVM button. This slip is visible for 7 seconds.
facts.fact_hi: VVPAT machine EVM button press करने के बाद एक paper slip print करती है। यह slip 7 seconds तक visible रहती है।

facts.fact_en: EVM results are stored in non-volatile memory. Removing the battery does not erase votes.
facts.fact_hi: EVM results non-volatile memory mein store hote hain. Battery nikalane se votes erase nahin hote.

facts.fact_en: EVMs are sealed with tamper-proof seals checked by candidates before voting begins.
facts.fact_hi: EVM ko tamper-proof seals se seal kiya jata hai jo candidates voting se pehle verify karte hain.

facts.fact_en: A mandatory mock poll is conducted before every election in presence of candidates to verify EVM accuracy.
facts.fact_hi: Har election se pehle candidates ki upasthiti mein mandatory mock poll hota hai.

facts.fact_en: EVMs are randomly allocated to polling booths via double-randomization to prevent targeting.
facts.fact_hi: EVMs ko double-randomization ke zariye polling booths mein randomly allocate kiya jata hai.

facts.fact_en: Supreme Court ordered VVPAT slips from 5 randomly selected booths per constituency to be cross-checked.
facts.fact_hi: Supreme Court ke order par har constituency mein 5 random booths ki VVPAT slips count ki jati hain.

facts.fact_en: EVMs have no radio frequency components. Signal jammers have no effect on them.
facts.fact_hi: EVMs mein koi radio frequency component nahin hai. Signal jammers ka koi asar nahin hota.

facts.fact_en: EVMs are manufactured only by BEL and ECIL, two government undertakings. No critical foreign components are used.
facts.fact_hi: EVM sirf do sarkari kampaniyon BEL aur ECIL dwara banayi jati hain.

facts.fact_en: After voting, EVMs are stored in sealed strongrooms with 3-tier security, CCTV, and central forces.
facts.fact_hi: Voting ke baad EVMs sealed strongrooms mein rakhi jati hain jahan CCTV aur central forces hoti hain.

facts.fact_en: EVMs do not record which voter pressed which button. Votes are completely anonymous.
facts.fact_hi: EVM record nahin karti ki kis voter ne kaunsa button press kiya. Votes puri tarah anonymous hote hain.

facts.fact_en: ECI has repeatedly invited public EVM hackathons. No one has successfully demonstrated tampering under controlled conditions.
facts.fact_hi: ECI ne baar-baar public EVM hackathons invite kiye. Controlled conditions mein koi tampering demonstrate nahin kar paya.

facts.fact_en: Citizens aged 18+ can register as voters online at voters.eci.gov.in using Form 6. Registration is free.
facts.fact_hi: 18+ naagarik voters.eci.gov.in par Form 6 se free mein voter registration kar sakte hain.

facts.fact_en: You must vote only at the polling booth listed on your voter slip. Voting at wrong booth is not permitted.
facts.fact_hi: Aapko sirf voter slip par listed booth par vote karna hota hai. Galat booth par vote allowed nahin.

facts.fact_en: Proxy voting is not permitted in India except for overseas service voters. Each person must vote personally.
facts.fact_hi: India mein proxy voting allowed nahin hai. Har vyakti ko personally vote karna hota hai.

facts.fact_en: Election Day is a paid holiday. Employers must grant paid leave to all employees to vote.
facts.fact_hi: Election Day ek paid holiday hai. Employers ko employees ko vote ke liye paid leave deni hoti hai.

facts.fact_en: Voters can call Voter Helpline 1950 to report any misbehavior at polling booths or election irregularities.
facts.fact_hi: Voters Voter Helpline 1950 par call karke kisi bhi irregularity ki report kar sakte hain.

facts.fact_en: Accepting bribes to vote for a candidate is illegal under IPC Section 171B, punishable with 1 year imprisonment.
facts.fact_hi: Vote ke badle rishwat lena IPC Section 171B ke tahat illegal hai. 1 saal ki jail ho sakti hai.

facts.fact_en: If you move to a new address, update registration using Form 8A so your name is not deleted from voter roll.
facts.fact_hi: Nayi jagah shift hone par Form 8A se registration update karein taaki aapka naam roll se na hate.

facts.fact_en: Booth capturing is a criminal offense under Section 135A of Representation of People Act, punishable with 1-3 years.
facts.fact_hi: Booth capturing Section 135A ke tahat criminal offense hai jisme 1-3 saal ki jail hoti hai.

facts.fact_en: Model Code of Conduct comes into force when elections are announced and remains till results are declared.
facts.fact_hi: Model Code of Conduct elections announce hone se result declare hone tak lagu rehta hai.

facts.fact_en: Exit polls cannot be telecast until the last phase of voting ends. Violation is punishable by law.
facts.fact_hi: Last phase ki voting khatam hone tak exit polls telecast nahin ho sakte.

facts.fact_en: Campaigning must stop 48 hours before polling day. No public meetings or processions are allowed in this period.
facts.fact_hi: Polling day se 48 ghante pehle campaigning band honi chahiye. Koi public meeting ya procession allowed nahin.

sources.title: Representation of the People Act Section 126

facts.fact_en: Armed forces, officials posted elsewhere and senior citizens aged 85+ can use postal ballot facility.
facts.fact_hi: Armed forces, bahar posted officials aur 85+ umra ke senior citizens postal ballot use kar sakte hain.

facts.fact_en: Disabled and elderly voters are entitled to priority entry at polling booths and assistance from an escort.
facts.fact_hi: Disabled aur elderly voters ko polling booth par priority entry milti hai aur woh sahayak ki madad le sakte hain.

facts.fact_en: Every candidate must declare their assets, liabilities and income in the ECI affidavit.
facts.fact_hi: Har candidate ko ECI affidavit mein assets, liabilities aur income declare karni hoti hai.

facts.fact_en: The minimum age to contest Lok Sabha or State Assembly elections is 25 years.
facts.fact_hi: Lok Sabha ya State Assembly elections mein contest karne ki minimum age 25 saal hai.

facts.fact_en: Lok Sabha candidates must deposit Rs.25,000 (Rs.12,500 for SC/ST) as security deposit with nomination.
facts.fact_hi: Lok Sabha candidates ko nomination ke saath Rs.25,000 (SC/ST ke liye Rs.12,500) security deposit deni hoti hai.

facts.fact_en: Lok Sabha candidates have a campaign spending limit of Rs.95 lakh per constituency in most states.
facts.fact_hi: Lok Sabha candidates ke liye campaign spending limit adhikansh states mein Rs.95 lakh per constituency hai.

facts.fact_en: A person convicted with 2+ year sentence is disqualified from contesting elections for 6 years after release.
facts.fact_hi: 2+ saal ki saza pane wala vyakti rihaee ke baad 6 saal tak elections contest karne ke liye disqualified hota hai.

sources.title: Representation of the People Act Section 8

facts.fact_en: Citizens can check any candidate criminal record, assets and education on the Voter Helpline App or ECI portal.
facts.fact_hi: Citizens Voter Helpline App ya ECI portal par kisi bhi candidate ka record dekh sakte hain.

facts.fact_en: Rajya Sabha members are elected by State Legislative Assembly members, not directly by citizens.
facts.fact_hi: Rajya Sabha ke members seedhe janta dwara nahin balki State Legislative Assembly members dwara elect kiye jaate hain.

facts.fact_en: Lok Sabha MPs serve a 5-year term unless the house is dissolved earlier. MLAs also serve 5-year terms.
facts.fact_hi: Lok Sabha MPs 5 saal ke liye serve karte hain jab tak house pehle dissolve na ho.

facts.fact_en: Independent candidates are allotted symbols from the ECI-approved list. They cannot use a recognized party symbol.
facts.fact_hi: Independent candidates ko ECI-approved list se symbols allot kiye jaate hain. Woh party symbol use nahin kar sakte.
